user.title: Configure Energy Insights
user.description: Select the Home Assistant sensors used to calculate electricity insights. The three current-month sensors are optional but provide live totals instead of Recorder's hourly statistics.

data_description.energy_total: A cumulative energy sensor used by the Energy dashboard, normally in kWh.
data_description.power: A current power sensor, normally in W or kW.
data_description.cost_gross_total: Optional cumulative gross electricity cost sensor.
data_description.cost_net_total: Optional cumulative net electricity cost sensor.
data_description.current_month_energy: Optional live monthly energy sensor, for example a monthly utility meter.
data_description.current_month_cost_gross: Optional live monthly gross cost sensor.
data_description.current_month_cost_net: Optional live monthly net cost sensor.
data_description.history_start: First month to include in the period selector.
data_description.price_net: Optional electricity price sensor excluding tax and VAT. Used for monthly and yearly price records.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Energy Insights
reconfigure.description: Change the source sensors used by Energy Insights.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Energy Insights instance can be configured.
